rankpatch: A vermilion replacement strip slides into a stack of ranked results.
rankseal: A serrated seal encloses three ordered bars to represent a ranking certified from partial lists.
rankfence: Two groups of ranked streams stop at a common cutoff, leaving later results unread.
cachepin: A pin holds the shared portion of three stacked prompt sheets at a cache breakpoint.
prefix-atlas: Nested contour lines represent the cache capacities explored for a target prompt-prefix hit rate.
cutstream: A blade cuts a stream at a stop sequence that straddles the seam between two chunks.
eventfold: A pleated frame carries a single highlighted edit across successive folds.
racecurve: A backup request starts later and races the first request toward the same deadline.
pathprobe-dag: Two dependency paths converge, with one task highlighted for duration analysis.
cloture: A fan of rollout ballots shows repeated circular votes for the same answer.
eproc: A sequence of evidence values rises and falls before crossing a stopping threshold.
